name: figma-mcp-bridge
description: Figma REPL MCP frontend with local Figma MCP login support.

interface.shortDescription: Use Figma MCP through a stateful REPL proxy with local Figma MCP login.
interface.longDescription: Provides the persistent figma-repl-mcp MCP server for the official Figma remote MCP endpoint, plus a local HTTP bridge used for Figma MCP login and credential caching. The transparent figma-stdio bridge remains available as an optional CLI and Node library surface for debugging.
